summary.tldr: Requires some registered parties to publish diversity information and directs the Chief Electoral Officer to collect and report demographic data on election contestants.
what_it_does: Requires certain registered parties, those that met a vote threshold in the most recent general election, to post on their websites their candidate selection rules, diversity policies, women candidate targets, and yearly progress.
Requires parties with no diversity policy, plan, or related rules to post a statement saying why, and any timeline for adopting them.
Requires registered parties to post the name and contact information of a person who can receive concerns about these website duties.

Directs the Chief Electoral Officer to collect voluntary self-identification information from candidates, nomination contestants, and leadership contestants, keep it confidential, and use it only for reporting.
Requires the Chief Electoral Officer to publish anonymized demographic reports after general elections, by-elections, and leadership contests.
summary.background: The bill amends the Canada Elections Act. It also adds the Employment Equity Act meaning of “designated groups” to the Canada Elections Act.
